title: 電気数学Ⅱ
subtitle: Mathematics for Electrical and Electronic Engineering II
keywords: Electical & electronic engineering 2.Fundamental mathematics 3.Differential calculus 4.Integral calculus 5.Vectors
educationalGoal: In this subject, students will learn fundamental mathematics related to electrical & electronic engineering, and will acquire basic knowledge of electric circuits, electromagnetism, and electronic circuits. The purpose of this subject is to develop the ability of applying fundamental mathematics to specific problems through physical and mathematical considerations. This subject is the basis of ``Electromagnetics I''.
advice: Cultivation of mathematical skills Students will learn the following mathematics that will be widely needed in the electrical & electronic fields. (1)Differential culcus deals with derivatives and derivative applications. (2)Integral culcus deals with indefinite integral, definite integral, line integral, and area integral. (3)Vectors deals with plane coordinates, spatial coordinates, scalar products, and vector products.
books: A textbook written in Japanese will be used.
requiredKnowledge: This subject is the basis of understanding electrical and electronic engineering. It is important to review mathematics (vectors, differential culcus, integral culcus) learned in high school. It is desirable to study areas that were not taken in high school using self-study and learning support systems in our university.

activityGoals.body: To understand how to calculate basic and advanced problems related to this subject.
